transcript.en: Good afternoon, Dreamtime Travel.
transcript.zh: 下午好，梦幻时光旅行社。

transcript.en: How can I help you?
transcript.zh: 我能帮你做什么？

transcript.en: Oh hello.
transcript.zh: 你好。

transcript.en: I'm interested in the holidays you offer along the coast near here.
transcript.zh: 我对你们提供的海岸假期感兴趣

transcript.en: Yes. We operate several tours up the coast. Where in particular did you want to go?
transcript.zh: 对，我们沿着海岸线经营几条旅程，你想去哪一个？

transcript.en: Well, I like the sound of the holiday that mentioned whales.
transcript.zh: 我喜欢有一个关于鲸鱼的假期

transcript.en: Was it Whale 'Watching'?
transcript.zh: 有一个“观看鲸鱼”的路线吗？

transcript.en: Oh, that's our Whale Watch Experience.
transcript.zh: 那是我们的观看鲸鱼之旅。

transcript.en: It's very popular and it's based in a lovely little town with nice beaches.
transcript.zh: 它很受欢迎而且是在一个漂亮的小镇上，有着美丽的海滩。

transcript.en: Oh right, and how long does it last?
transcript.zh: 好的，这趟旅行要多长时间？

transcript.en: It's two days - that includes four hours' travel time each way from here.
transcript.zh: 两天时间，包括从这里单程四个小时的旅行时间。

transcript.en: Good, I don't want to be away any longer than that.
transcript.zh: 很好，我不想离开的时间比这个更久。

transcript.en: So is that by coach?
transcript.zh: 那么是乘坐长途汽车去吗？

transcript.en: Actually it's by minibus.
transcript.zh: 事实上是坐小巴去。

transcript.en: We like to keep those tours small and personal so we don't take a whole coachload of people.
transcript.zh: 我们希望提供小型、私人化的行程，所以我们不会载着一整辆长途汽车的人。

transcript.en: In fact, we only take up to fifteen people on this tour, although we do run it with just twelve or thirteen.
transcript.zh: 事实上，我们的这项旅行只接纳15人，但是12或13个人也可以。

transcript.en: Oh, right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: So do you run these tours often?
transcript.zh: 那么你们经常有这些旅行吗？

transcript.en: Well it depends on the time of year.
transcript.zh: 这取决于一年中的时间。

transcript.en: Of course in peak times like the summer holidays we do them every weekend, but at the moment it's usually once a month at most.
transcript.zh: 在旺季，如夏日暑假的时候，我们当然每周末都有，但是平时我们最多一个月一次。

transcript.en: And when is the next one going?
transcript.zh: 下一次是什么呢？

transcript.en: Mmm, let me see.
transcript.zh: 让我看看。

transcript.en: Um, there's one in three weeks' time which is April the 18th, and then we don't have another one until June the 2nd.
transcript.zh: 三周后有一次是在4月18日，之后直到6月2日才有了。

transcript.en: All right, and is April a good time to go?
transcript.zh: 好的，四月是去那里的好时间吗？

transcript.en: Pretty good, though the really good time is later in the year.
transcript.zh: 很不错，尽管最好的时间是一年中的晚些时间。

transcript.en: I have to say though that the whale sighting is only one of the many things offered.
transcript.zh: 不得不说观看鲸鱼只是众多项目中的一个

transcript.en: Really?
transcript.zh: 真的吗？

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: The hotel itself where you stay has great facilities.
transcript.zh: 你住的酒店有很棒的设施。

transcript.en: It's called The Pallisades.
transcript.zh: 它叫做The Pallisades。

transcript.en: The Paris what?
transcript.zh: 巴黎什么？

transcript.en: No, it's actually The Pallisades, P - A - L - L - I - S - A - D - E - S.
transcript.zh: 不，它叫做The Pallisades，P-A-L-L-I- S-A-D-E -S。

transcript.en: It's right on the main beach there.
transcript.zh: 它就在海滩上。

transcript.en: Oh, I see.
transcript.zh: 我懂了。

transcript.en: All of the rooms have nice views and the food is really good there too.
transcript.zh: 所有房间都能看到很好的景色，吃的东西也不错。

transcript.en: Oh right.
transcript.zh: 好。

transcript.en: And what about the other things?
transcript.zh: 那么其他的事情呢？

transcript.en: You know, that are included in the price.
transcript.zh: 你知道，包括在这个价钱里的事情。

transcript.en: Oh, there are lots of things.
transcript.zh: 还有很多事情。

transcript.en: If you don't want to do the whale watch cruise, your guide will take anyone who is interested either on a bushwalk through the national park near the hotel, and there's no extra charge for that, or on a fishing trip.
transcript.zh: 如果你不想乘船观看鲸鱼，你的导游将带你到酒店附近的国家公园漫步，这项活动不收取额外费用，或者带你去钓鱼。

transcript.en: That's an extra $12 I think.
transcript.zh: 我想这个会收取额外的12美元。

transcript.en: And there's also a reptile park in town - that costs more or less the same.
transcript.zh: 另外在小镇上还有爬行动物公园，价钱跟这个差不多。

transcript.en: No, I think I'd prefer whales to snakes.
transcript.zh: 不，我想比起蛇，我更喜欢鲸鱼。

transcript.en: Yeah. And if you just want to relax you are free to sit by the hotel pool or go down the beach.
transcript.zh: 如果你想休息，你可以免费去酒店的泳池或海滩，

transcript.en: Oh, and they also have tennis courts at the hotel, but you have to pay for those by the hour.
transcript.zh: 酒店还有网球场，但是你得按小时付费。

transcript.en: But there are table tennis tables downstairs and they're part of the accommodation package.
transcript.zh: 但是楼下有兵乓球桌，住宿费里包括这一项。

transcript.en: Just speak to your guide.
transcript.zh: 所以只要和导游说一声就行。

transcript.en: Well that sounds good.
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。

transcript.en: So how much is the basic tour price?
transcript.zh: 那么基础旅游价格是多少。

transcript.en: At this time of year it's usually around $300 but let me check.
transcript.zh: 一年中的这个时节是在300美元左右，但是让我查查，

transcript.en: Er...oh，it's actually $280.
transcript.zh: 事实上是280美元。

transcript.en: And the next tour, are there any places on that one?
transcript.zh: 下一趟旅行还有空缺吗？

transcript.en: How many people is it for?
transcript.zh: 要去多少人？

transcript.en: There are two of us.
transcript.zh: -两个人。

transcript.en: Yes, that should be fine.
transcript.zh: 好的，没问题。

transcript.en: Can I just mention that we require all bookings to be made at least fourteen days before you travel to avoid cancellations of tours.
transcript.zh: 为了防止取消行程，我们要求所有预定至少在旅行前的14天做好。

transcript.en: And if you cancel within seven days of departure you will have to pay 50% of your total booking.
transcript.zh: 如果你在出发前7天内取消，你将不得不付50%的预定费，

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: And you also need to pay a 20% deposit at the time of booking.
transcript.zh: 预订时，你还得付20%的押金。

transcript.en: Can I pay that by credit card?
transcript.zh: 我能用信用卡支付吗？

transcript.en: Yes, you can.
transcript.zh: 可以的。

transcript.en: All right, what I'll do is I'll talk to my partner and get back to you.
transcript.zh: 好的，我跟我的伙伴说一声，然后再打给你。

transcript.en: Fine.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: So I'll make a provisional booking, shall I?
transcript.zh: 那么我先做一个临时预定？

transcript.en: Two for the Whale Watch Experience.
transcript.zh: 两个观看鲸鱼之旅。

transcript.en: Let me issue you with a customer reference number for when you call back.
transcript.zh: 我给你一个客户咨询号以便你下次打回来查询。

transcript.en: Do you have a pen?
transcript.zh: 你有笔吗？

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 有。

transcript.en: OK, it's three nine seven, four five, T.
That's T for tango.
transcript.zh: Tango（探戈舞）的那个T。

transcript.en: When you call back, ask to speak to the Tour Manager, that's me, Tracy.
transcript.zh: 再打来时就找领队，就是我，特蕾西。

transcript.en: Fine, I will.
transcript.zh: 好的，我会的。
